messages:
eva: quick note for tomorrow's KPI sync 
we're seeing 387 leads in the launch window on the dashboard but downstream systems show fewer. want to line up numbers before the readout :mag:
max: which downstream? hubspot or sfdc? or both
jules: hubspot has 262 tagged with utm_campaign=launch-q2, sfdc shows ~250 in the same interval
priya: could be multi-touch + webinar crossflow. a lot of folks came through the launch post then immediately registered for the webinar via the link
chris (revops): confirm attribution method: dash = multi-first-touch aggregation (14d); HS = last-touch (7d). that mismatch is the main culprit
eva: ok. let's show three columns on the one-pager: dashboard raw, deduped distinct contacts, HS-tagged. action list?
max: i'll add a short explainer on the dashboard: "why numbers differ: attribution windows & routing" and add the toggle to view last-touch
jules: i'll produce a dedupe export (distinct email) for the launch window and share counts + top domains
priya: i'll split webinar referrals out of the launch cohort so we can show overlap vs unique launch-only leads
metric-bot: weekly-kpi: dash_launch=387, dedup_distinct=336, hubspot_tagged=262, sfdc_pipeline=250, webinar_signups=98
jules: quick SQL i'm running:
```sql
select count(distinct email) as unique_leads, utm_campaign
from events.leads
where received_at >= '2026-03-09' and received_at < '2026-03-16'
group by utm_campaign;
```
results incoming in ~4 mins
eva: timeline: post the dedupe in this thread, max update the dash note, priya post the overlap pivot. meet TOM 9:15 to finalize slate for the exec readout
chris (revops): also add a tiny metric: conv-to-mql (%) for the cohort. CRO will ask about quality not just volume
priya: adding that now. will show conv->mql sparkline plus median time to MQL
eva: perfect. thanks team! :white_check_mark:
